Introduction

This book covers food safety for professional cooks.

Safety Basics

Foodborne Illness

Foodborne illness is caused by eating contaminated food.

Causes of Foodborne Illness

There are three types of hazards (biological, chemical and physical) .

  • Bacteria
    • Salmonella
    • Listeria
  • Viruses
